name: zcode-tps-monitor
description: Token output-rate monitor for ZCode: shows real instant tokens/sec (from ZCode usage DB) for the just-finished turn via a Stop hook, a /tps command, MCP tools, and a real-time dashboard; also supports service-TPS monitoring via a configurable metrics URL or demo data.

description_i18n.en: TPS throughput monitor: /tps command and MCP tools to snapshot TPS, latency percentiles, error rate, and local system resources. Supports a real metrics URL or built-in demo data.
description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode Token 输出速率监控：每轮回复结束时自动显示本轮即时 tok/s（读取 ZCode usage 数据库），另有 /tps 命令、MCP 工具与实时大屏；同时支持业务 TPS 监控（可配置指标接口或演示数据）。

metrics_url.title: Metrics URL
metrics_url.description: HTTP 接口地址，返回包含 tps/qps 字段的 JSON；留空则使用演示数据。
